fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Birth date of the person in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the forecast range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today (UTC).

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the forecast range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to startDate + 30 days. Maximum range: 90 days.
